_how_to_use: DRAFT tiers, not final. The three levels per service are a starting layout built only from what each service already lists on the website (Basic = the first items, Standard = more, Premium = all). Nothing is priced and nothing is published: set price (and delivery_days, revisions) on the ones you really sell, set published to true, and edit the lists freely. Items with price null are skipped by the loader. Copy this file to content/catalog.json, then run: python manage.py load_content content/catalog.json (preview) and again with --apply.
